description: Compares one voltage against a threshold and sends one of two other voltages, modified or not, to a single output

params.text: Takes a fresh reading of the source voltage, as a rising edge at the trigger jack does
Sets the voltage the source is compared against, -10V to 10V; above it the left half is used, at or below it the right half
Adds -10V to 10V to that half's input before it is multiplied
In the Modify position the source voltage is added to that half's input before the offset and scale; in Replace the source is dropped and only that half's input is used

inputs.text: A rising edge here takes a fresh reading of the source voltage
Sets the comparison threshold, and overrides the threshold knob while patched
The voltage that half sends on, after its offset and scale and, in Modify, with the source added
The voltage that is compared against the threshold, and the one Modify adds in

outputs.text: Carries the result of whichever half the comparison picked
Sends a 1ms pulse when the comparison changes over to that half, and the lamp above lights while that half is the one in use

notes: with nothing patched to the trigger jack the source is read continuously; patch a trigger there and the source is only read on a rising edge
the output is recalculated only when the source voltage changes, so turning the offset, scale or threshold knobs does nothing until the source moves

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
